dict.string: Swappro uses the camera so you can take photos for your profile and for items you list or edit. For example, you can photograph a bicycle you want to swap so other users can see the item and its condition.

Swappro uses your location only while you are using the app to place a listing on the map. For example, when you tap Use my location while creating a listing, we center the map on your current area so others know where the item is available. Swappro does not track your location in the background.
